chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The Qur’an contains news about the past, foretellings about the future, and commandments for the present.

key_terms.خَبَرُ: Information or tidings, often implying future or general knowledge
key_terms.مَا بَيْنَكُمْ: What is between you (the present/current era)
key_terms.نَبَأُ: News or account of past events

ai.seo_question: What are the three main aspects of the Qur'an's guidance according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates the Qur’an’s comprehensive nature by categorizing its content into three temporal dimensions: news of previous nations (past), prophecies of future events (future), and legal rulings for the current community (present). This hadith highlights the Qur’an as a complete guide covering history, eschatology, and jurisprudence, reflecting the Shia scholarly view of the text as both a historical record and a living legal source.
